title: Bio
case_ids_frozen_by: P11 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P11-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.entry_conditions: Public resource and Design System patterns are available on the integrated main baseline.
capability_contract.goal: Create, edit, preview, publish, pause and remove Bio pages with fail-closed child-link safety, responsive public rendering and permanent V10 UGC noindex/sitemap exclusion.
capability_contract.gate_scope: P11 closes CAP-BIO and only the P11 Bio UGC/noindex contribution to G7; release-wide G7 remains later-owned by P18/P19/P20/P22. P11 consumes current-repository destination-risk authority but does not claim P16 completion of the broader CAP-DESTINATION-RISK review/admin lifecycle.

route_contract.workspace_api_authority_note: The approved IA names required Bio APIs and route-using Bio APIs but does not freeze exact Workspace HTTP method/path families. The following family is frozen by P11 as the current-repository implementation contract and must not be represented as IA-exact authority.

public_contract.page: GET /p/{slug} is IA-exact PUB-BIO browser authority.
public_contract.machine: GET /api/public/bio/{slug} is the IA-exact public Bio API dependency and repeats publication/removal and child-link safety authority.
public_contract.blocked_child_behavior: A published page may remain 200 in risk-blocked-child-link state, but review/blocked child destinations must not remain active href/navigation targets.
public_contract.legacy_aliases: PROHIBITED unless later specification change control creates a Route ID and removal plan

resource_contract.slug_authority: opaque server-generated public slug; internal IDs are not public path authority
resource_contract.content_authority: Bio title, profile text and link labels are UTF-8 data and must never execute as HTML/script.
resource_contract.link_authority: Only normalized http/https child destinations may be stored; javascript/data/credential-bearing or malformed targets are rejected server-side.
resource_contract.risk_authority: Every child destination is bound to a normalized destination fingerprint and current-repository risk result. A changed destination invalidates the prior allow result and must be re-evaluated before becoming navigable.
resource_contract.publication_authority: Only server-authoritative published state may expose profile content publicly. Draft is public 404; paused is an explicit noindex public state with no active child navigation; removed is 410.
resource_contract.conflict_authority: versioned optimistic concurrency; stale page mutation returns 409
resource_contract.delete_authority: removed/deleted public access is 410 and stale writes cannot resurrect authority

deferred_contract.p11_rule: No P11 API, database field, Workspace control or public query may enable indexing. Bio remains noindex and absent from sitemaps for all V10 P11 states.

seo_contract.soft_404: Unknown/unpublished and removed resources must not be represented as generic 200 success pages; paused is an explicit IA public state, not a not-found substitute.

environment_contract.mysql: Real MySQL 8.x authoritative Bio page/link persistence, publication and risk-state binding.
environment_contract.platformapi: Real native Go platformapi; fixture/in-memory substitution is insufficient for Exit evidence.
environment_contract.destination_risk: Current-repository P05 destination-risk safety authority is required for child-link allow/review/block evidence; P11 does not claim P16 admin/review completion.
environment_contract.workspace_browser: Built Workspace app consuming real P11 APIs.
environment_contract.public_http: Real native platformapi/public Bio HTML and API responses with raw status/header/body evidence.

cases.name: Create and list Bio pages persist authoritative Workspace draft state
cases.precondition: Real MySQL; authenticated Workspace manage actor.
cases.oracle: Create persists one same-Workspace draft Bio page with opaque server slug, owner/version timestamps and ordered child-link collection; list returns only same-Workspace pages.

cases.name: Bio page and child-link validation reject malformed or executable authority
cases.precondition: Valid and malformed create/update payloads against real platformapi.
cases.oracle: Server validates profile fields, link labels/order and destination URLs; only normalized http/https targets are accepted; executable/malformed/credential-bearing targets fail without partial publication.

cases.name: Authentication ownership tenant isolation and RBAC protect Bio CRUD and publish actions
cases.precondition: Signed-out actor, two Workspaces, read-only and manage actors.
cases.oracle: Signed-out access is denied, read-only cannot mutate/publish, cross-Workspace actors cannot infer or mutate pages, and manage permission is enforced server-side for every mutation.

cases.name: Optimistic version conflict prevents lost Bio edits
cases.precondition: One Bio page with concurrent/current and stale edit versions.
cases.oracle: Current version updates atomically; stale page/link mutation returns 409 and cannot overwrite the committed page or child-link order.

cases.name: Delete and removal lifecycle is durable and non-resurrecting
cases.precondition: Existing draft and published Bio pages with manage actor.
cases.oracle: Delete/removal is authorized and durable; removed public page/API return 410, child destinations are not exposed, and stale writes cannot resurrect publication.

cases.name: Publish transition exposes only server-authorized Bio content with HTTP 200
cases.precondition: Draft Bio page whose child links all have current allowed safety state.
cases.oracle: Publish records authoritative published_at/status; GET /p/{slug} and GET /api/public/bio/{slug} return 200 with safe profile data and only currently allowed child navigation.

cases.name: Draft and pause authority fail closed without exposing active child navigation
cases.precondition: Draft page and published page transitioned to paused.
cases.oracle: Draft/unpublished public access is 404; paused PUB-BIO is the explicit 200 paused state but exposes no active child href/navigation and can be resumed only by authorized Workspace action.

cases.name: Allowed outbound Bio links render as UGC nofollow links
cases.precondition: Published Bio page with multiple currently allowed http/https destinations.
cases.oracle: Rendered outbound links preserve owner-defined label/order, use normalized destinations, include rel containing ugc and nofollow, and do not expose internal risk evidence or tenant fields.

cases.name: Risk-review and blocked child links fail closed on the published Bio surface
cases.precondition: Published page with one allowed, one review and one blocked child destination using real current-repository safety authority.
cases.oracle: Page may remain 200 in IA risk-blocked-child-link state, but review/blocked children have no active href/navigation target while allowed children remain usable; raw response leaks no provider/risk secret evidence.

cases.name: Changing a child destination invalidates stale allow state and requires new risk authority
cases.precondition: Published page with an allowed child then mutated to a different destination.
cases.oracle: Destination fingerprint changes; the previous allow result cannot authorize the new target; child enters review/blocked until current risk authority permits it, with no stale public href window.

cases.name: Public Bio API mirrors publication/removal and safe-link authority without internal leakage
cases.precondition: Published, paused, draft, removed and unknown Bio fixtures.
cases.oracle: GET /api/public/bio/{slug} follows 200/404/410 lifecycle authority, never exposes Workspace IDs/internal risk evidence, and never returns active review/blocked child destinations.

cases.name: Bio quota and failed publish are transactional and non-escalating
cases.precondition: Workspace at configured Bio quota plus a page with unresolved child safety state.
cases.oracle: Over-quota create is rejected server-side without partial page; publish with unresolved unsafe authority fails closed without changing authoritative published state or exposing child targets.

cases.name: Every Bio UGC HTML and public API response is permanently noindex
cases.precondition: Published, paused, risk-blocked-child-link, removed, draft and unknown lifecycle fixtures.
cases.oracle: HTML carries robots noindex and response headers carry applicable X-Robots-Tag; public Bio API carries X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow on success/error statuses.

cases.name: Bio UGC is excluded from Website and Docs sitemaps and has no canonical hreflang or structured data
cases.precondition: Current route/SEO outputs, sitemap artifacts and representative Bio public responses.
cases.oracle: No /p/{slug} is emitted into Website/Docs sitemaps; sitemap diff has zero Bio additions; PUB-BIO has no canonical/hreflang/structured data; unknown/draft and removed use 404/410 instead of generic 200 success.

cases.name: Deferred Bio owner opt-in indexing remains absent and cannot expand the index surface
cases.precondition: Workspace/API/public contracts and representative create/update/publish payloads.
cases.oracle: CAP-BIO-OPT-IN-INDEX remains DEFERRED: no API field, persisted authority, Workspace control or query can enable index/canonical/sitemap membership; attempted index input is rejected or ignored fail-closed while public output stays noindex.

cases.name: APP-BIO list/create route covers loading empty edit preview publish-error and quota states
cases.precondition: Built Workspace using real platformapi/MySQL with owner and read-only actors plus controlled quota/error fixtures.
cases.oracle: Route-backed /app/bio renders the IA state set without mocked request interception; create navigates to the real detail route and quota/publish-error are real server outcomes.

cases.name: APP-BIO-DETAIL editor preview publish and child-link safety states are route-backed
cases.precondition: Built Workspace, real page fixtures and current risk authority for allowed/review/blocked links.
cases.oracle: Route-backed /app/bio/{pageId} covers loading/draft/preview/published/child-link-review/child-link-block/conflict/deleted; public preview/publish action reaches real /p/{slug} and blocked links are non-navigable.

cases.name: Bio Workspace and public surfaces satisfy canonical responsive mobile and accessibility evidence
cases.precondition: Real owner Workspace/public page in system Chromium at Design System canonical desktop/tablet/mobile viewports plus 320px reflow and reduced-motion contexts.
cases.oracle: List/detail/public surfaces have zero horizontal overflow or clipped actionable content, keyboard-visible focus, non-color safety state text, usable reduced-motion behavior and public outbound rel=ugc nofollow at mobile and canonical viewports.

cases.name: Exact-head Bio evidence coherence binds T001 through T018 producers and captures
cases.precondition: P11 Contract, real integration and Workspace/Public browser producers completed successfully on one exact HEAD.
cases.oracle: T001..T018 are PASS with empty errors and one implementation SHA; producer run/artifact IDs and SHA-256 digests are bound; browser captures and sitemap diff are inspectable and semantically consistent.

cases.name: Signed exact-head P11 closure binds affected regression matrix predecessor authority and accountable review
cases.precondition: T001..T019 coherent exact-head evidence, affected P00-P11 workflows green, authoritative P10 signed closure available, and P11 review eligible for signature.
cases.oracle: Pre-sign closure is PASS but merge-authoritative=false; the review-only child commit records accountable approvals/P0=0/P1=0/DECISION REQUIRED=0; signed HEAD reruns the whole matrix and closes only when phase=signed and merge-authoritative=true.

closure_contract.predecessor_rule: P11 closure inherits the already-signed authoritative P10 closure from source commit 7db4fca49ba3fd8e60600ecdf41847c7e2f94776; it must not rerun P10 revision-specific closure on a P11 HEAD and reinterpret it.
closure_contract.gate_scope: P11 CAP-BIO G3 plus P11 Bio UGC/noindex G7 subset only; full G7 and P16 destination-risk admin/review completion remain later-owned.
